import sys

def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    index = 0
    T = int(input[index])
    index += 1
    results = []
    for _ in range(T):
        N = int(input[index])
        index += 1
        B = list(map(int, input[index:index + N]))
        index += N
        if all(B[i] == i + 1 for i in range(N)):
            results.append("YES")
        else:
            results.append("NO")
    print("\n".join(results))

main()
